method: OPEN AND QUOTED, from the 'Typhoid fever' chapter of the Australian Immunisation Handbook, retrieved 2026-09-23. Every pass claim is machine re-checkable. Quoted with attribution on the same footing as the Stroke Foundation, Kidney Health Australia and NHFA/CSANZ sources already in this compendium.

claims.claim: **Recommended for: military personnel · laboratory workers who routinely handle *Salmonella* Typhi · travellers aged 2 and over going to typhoid-endemic regions.**
claims.source_text: military personnel laboratory workers who routinely work with Salmonella Typhi travellers aged ≥2 years travelling to typhoid- endemic regions
claims.locator: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, 'Typhoid fever', The Australian Immunisation Handbook, at https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/typhoid-fever, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Injectable — Typhim Vi: 1 dose IM**, registered from **age 2**.
claims.source_text: Administration route: Intramuscular injection Registered for use in people aged ≥2 years. Monovalent parenteral Vi polysaccharide typhoid vaccine
claims.locator: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, 'Typhoid fever', The Australian Immunisation Handbook, at https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/typhoid-fever, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Oral — Vivotif (live attenuated): 1 capsule on days 1, 3 and 5 — and day 7 on a 4-dose schedule — taken 1 hour before food.** Registered from **age 6**. **4 doses may protect better than 3.**
claims.source_text: The vaccination schedule for oral typhoid vaccine consists of 1 capsule on days 1, 3 and 5 (and day 7 if following a 4-dose schedule) taken 1 hour before food. … Registered for use in people aged ≥6 years. Monovalent oral live attenuated typhoid vaccine … the 4th dose on day 7 is an option - 4 doses may provide better protection than 3
claims.locator: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing, 'Typhoid fever', The Australian Immunisation Handbook, at https://immunisationhandbook.health.gov.au/contents/vaccine-preventable-diseases/typhoid-fever, retrieved 2026-09-23
